decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays by using cheap threats and disruption to control the board and pressure the opponent. It utilizes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Delver of Secrets backed up by efficient instants like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain tempo advantage with cards like Daze and Brainstorm. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive strategy and ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive threats early on, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure, while also generating card advantage with Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the board with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also having access to counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its own threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive tempo strategy with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly generate and utilize mana resources in order to cast powerful spells and activate various combo pieces. The deck focuses on using cards like Rite of Flame and Grim Monolith to generate large amounts of mana, while also using cards like Burning Wish and Overmaster to search for key combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Defense Grid to disrupt opponent's interaction and protect its own combo. The goal is to assemble the necessary components and execute a game-winning combo, utilizing the resources efficiently.

This deck aims to quickly establish board presence with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponent's plays with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck focuses on tempo advantage by utilizing cards that can draw cards and filter through the deck quickly, such as Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. By applying pressure early on and maintaining control over the game with targeted removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing various Elf creatures to ramp up mana quickly and search for key combo pieces, such as Gaea's Cradle and Craterhoof Behemoth, to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful finish. It also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Opposition Agent to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order to search for specific creatures, the deck aims to create a strong board presence early on and combo off for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and blue spells to create a fast and aggressive playstyle. By using cards like Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Urza's Saga to generate mana and card advantage, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents. Cards like Sai, Master Thopterist and Emry, Lurker of the Loch provide additional value by creating thopter tokens and recurring artifacts from the graveyard. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will helps control the game and protect key pieces, making it difficult for opponents to stop the onslaught of artifact creatures and spells.

The main concept of this deck is to use the powerful combo card Doomsday to set up a winning combination of cards in your library. By carefully selecting the right cards and using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to manipulate your draw, you can assemble a winning sequence of plays that will lead to victory. Additionally, cards like Force of Will and Daze help protect your game plan while cards like Thassa's Oracle provide a win condition once your combo is assembled. This deck focuses on efficient card selection and manipulation to outplay your opponent.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plays through hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while also utilizing disruptive cards like Magus of the Moon and Skyclave Apparition. It seeks to control the board with creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and equipment like Umezawa's Jitte, while also applying pressure with aggro creatures like Solitude and Timeless Dragon. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategies to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful control cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while leveraging cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to find key pieces and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by flickering permanents. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements while also including utility lands like Wasteland and Karakas.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It aims to control the board with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while utilizing Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition for removal and disruption. The deck also includes strong equipment like Umezawa's Jitte, Kaldra Compleat, and Batterskull to enhance its creatures. With Aether Vial for mana acceleration, the deck aims to lock down opponents with cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Mother of Runes, ultimately controlling the game's pace and tempo.

The deck aims to win the game quickly by using the Doomsday combo to stack the deck and win with Thassa's Oracle. It includes cards like Street Wraith and Grief to disrupt opponents, while also utilizing cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to generate fast mana. The deck also includes a suite of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces, along with disruption like Force of Will. Overall, the deck is focused on assembling the combo quickly and efficiently to win the game in a single turn.

The core strategy of this Elves combo deck is to quickly generate a large number of mana through cards like Gaea's Cradle and Elvish Mystic, allowing for explosive plays. The deck utilizes cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for powerful creatures such as Craterhoof Behemoth, creating a massive boost in power and often leading to an immediate victory. The deck also includes various utility creatures like Wirewood Symbiote and Elvish Visionary to generate card advantage and keep the engine running. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and devastating combo.

This deck aims to quickly establish board control through aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's plans with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. Murktide Regent provides a powerful finisher for the deck. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to handle threats. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's game plan, utilizing fetch lands and dual lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast-paced, tempo-driven playstyle to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By playing threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent early on, backed up by countermagic like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. With incremental advantage from cards like Expressive Iteration and Brainstorm, along with land hate cards like Wasteland, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain tempo throughout the match.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent using a combination of aggressive creatures and tempo spells. By playing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, along with disruptive spells such as Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to apply pressure while maintaining control of the game. This deck also utilizes cards like Brazen Borrower and Pyroblast to deal with problematic threats from the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the right cards at the right time.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to quickly apply pressure to the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Using cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler alongside countermagic like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the board and protect its threats. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Brazen Borrower provide additional removal options, while cards like Expressive Iteration and Ponder help to generate card advantage and smooth out draws. The land base includes key dual lands and Wasteland to ensure consistent mana development and disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on aggressive play using artifact cards to control the board and generate value through various triggers. It relies on quickly dropping powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur resources. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will to protect its key pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the strategy is to flood the board with artifacts, generate card advantage, and overwhelm the opponent with a quick and powerful assault.

The main concept of this Dark Depths combo deck is to quickly assemble the Dark Depths + Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 flying indestructible Marit Lage token, and win the game in just a few turns. The deck uses various cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to tutor for the combo pieces, along with cards like Mox Diamond and Knight of the Reliquary to ramp up mana production. Additionally, the deck has removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats from the opponent.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to assemble the necessary cards and resources to set up a winning Thassa's Oracle win condition. By utilizing cards like Force of Will and Duress for protection and disruption, along with cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal for fast mana generation, the deck aims to quickly dig through the library with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find and set up the perfect Doomsday pile to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck seeks to efficiently and consistently execute its combo plan to secure victories in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo using fast mana and cantrips to draw the necessary pieces. Thassa's Oracle is the win condition, with Lion's Eye Diamond providing additional mana for the combo. Protection is provided by Force of Will and Pact of Negation, while disruption is achieved through Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, able to win the game in a single turn through careful planning and execution of the Doomsday pile.

The main concept of this deck revolves around playing aggressive creatures like Legion Warboss and Goblin Rabblemaster, while disrupting opponents with cards like Magus of the Moon and Chalice of the Void. The goal is to lock out opponents with cards like Blood Moon and Trinisphere, while using fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to quickly ramp into powerful threats. The deck aims to control the board and pressure opponents with a relentless assault, utilizing the Stompy archetype to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This deck relies on fast mana generation and tutoring effects to quickly assemble a lethal board presence of Elves, with the goal of casting powerful creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide or Craterhoof Behemoth. Cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order are key to finding these key combo pieces, while Allosaurus Shepherd provides protection from countermagic. The deck also utilizes cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to generate additional mana and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful Elf creatures and combo finishers.

The deck focuses on using creatures like Elves to ramp up and generate mana quickly, utilizing cards like Gaea's Cradle and Wirewood Symbiote. It relies on combo pieces like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large army of creatures. It also includes disruption elements like Collector Ouphe and Opposition Agent to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The main goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game through a powerful combination of creatures and spells.

The deck revolves around quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Worldgorger Dragon and Griselbrand, then using spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Dance of the Dead to bring them back into play for a powerful combo finish. Key pieces like Entomb, Dark Ritual, and Cabal Therapy help enable the strategy by either putting critical combo pieces into the graveyard or disrupting the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient reanimation engine, leading to explosive turns and victories.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with high-value creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, and then bring them back into play using spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Exhume. By combining fast mana acceleration with efficient reanimation spells, the deck can quickly cheat powerful creatures into play, overwhelming the opponent with massive threats. The inclusion of disruption like Thoughtseize and Unmask helps protect the combo pieces and allow for a smooth execution of the reanimation strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes, along with powerful cards like Punishing Fire and Sylvan Library to maintain pressure on opponents. It also utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces to disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Ramunap Excavator provide additional graveyard hate and recurring land destruction, allowing the deck to adapt to various matchups while maintaining a proactive game plan.

The focus of this deck is to assemble the Dark Depths combo by using cards like Crop Rotation, Sylvan Safekeeper, and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token quickly. The deck also includes cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to find the necessary combo pieces, along with cards like Swords to Plowshares for disruption and Mox Diamond for acceleration. The deck aims to control the board and win the game through the powerful Dark Depths combo.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and efficient creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Stoneforge Mystic. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up resources and card advantage. By utilizing powerful cards like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and protect its win conditions, such as Umezawa's Jitte and Batterskull. With a mix of control elements and versatile threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a game of attrition.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and powerful spells to control the tempo of the game and apply pressure to the opponent quickly. By using cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan, combined with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan. Additionally, with a mana base focused on disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland and utilizing cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards, this deck aims to stay ahead of the opponent in both cards and tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the tempo of the game by utilizing efficient and powerful spells and creatures in a UR (Blue-Red) color combination. By using cards like Brazen Borrower, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield. The deck also utilizes card selection and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and maintain a fast pace throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to dominate the board and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful threats like Snapcaster Mage and Monastery Mentor allows for proactive plays while maintaining control of the game. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent casting of spells throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of disruptive elements, graveyard hate, and powerful combo pieces to win the game. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Thoughtseize, Opposition Agent, and Sudden Edict, while also shutting down their graveyard strategies with Leyline of the Void and Dauthi Voidwalker. The combo pieces of Helm of Obedience and Leyline of the Void allow the player to mill opponents' entire libraries, ensuring victory. Additional support cards, such as Karn, the Great Creator and Retrofitter Foundry, provide versatile options and powerful synergies for the deck.
